we identified a novel 3'UTRA polymorphism of the BRCA2 gene, and we found a statistically significant relationship of a 3'UTA polymorphism of the BRCAl gene and BRCA1 mutation.
a polymorphism in the 3'-untranslated region of the BRÇA1 gene, c.1287C>T, was found to be statistically significant in patients with early-onset and familial breast cancer, but not in controls.
a novel polymorphism was identified in the 3'-UTR of BRCAA2 and that a novel BRCA1 polymorphism may be a risk factor for the development of familial and/or early onset breast cancer.

the identification of genetic variations in BRCA1/ 2 genes as risk factor for the development of breast cancer.
identifying genetic markers for early-onset and familial breast cancer.
the identification of genetic variants that may be associated with an increased breast cancer risk.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the c.*1287T allele of the BRCA 1 gene is a genetic risk marker for the development of familial and early-onse breast cancer in the Turkish population, and this polymorphism should be considered as an important genetic risk factor in genetic counseling and screening of patients with familial and early-onsets breast cancer.
the 3' UTR polymorphisms of BRCA1 gene are associated with breast cancer risk in Turkish population.

the 3' UTR polymorphism of BRCA1 c.*1287T (rs12516), which is in complete linkage disequilibrium with BRCA1 3'UTRA 3'UTRB c.*1290G>C (rs8176311), is a risk factor for breast cancer in the Turkish population.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
BRCA1 3'UTr SNP c.*1285C>T is associated with BRCA1 mutation in breast cancer.

the BRCA1 3'UTr SNP c.*1286C>T (rs. 12516) may be a potential marker for early-onset breast carcinoma and familial breast carcinoma in Turkey.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the 3' UTRs of BRCA1/BRCa2 are polymorphic in the Turkish population and that the BRCA1 c.*1287T (rs12516 variant is associated with BRCA1 mutation status.
we have identified a new genetic marker of breast cancer susceptibility, which is a single nucleotide polymorphism in the 3'-untranslated region of the BRC1 gene.
